name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Bookshelf Sign With Wooden Number Cards
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Main Sign: Crafted from premium natural wood, this product features a 2-layer wooden structure for enhanced depth and durability. Layer 1 & Layer 2: 3mm thick wood
    - Number Cards: Made from durable wooden material, 3mm thickness.
    - Hanging Bar: wooden hanging bar, 5mm thickness, designed specifically for 1-layer or 2-layer structures for enhanced stability.
    - Accessories Included:
    → 2 adhesive plastic pads for easy, drill-free installation.
    → 2 metal hanging hooks for secure and flexible hanging options.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    -  Available in multiple sizes to suit different display needs:
    →  5 x 4 inches ~ 12.7 x 10.16 cm
    →  7 x 6 inches ~ 17.78 x 15.24 cm
    →  8 x 7 inches ~ 20.32 x 17.78 cm
    →  9 x 8 inches ~ 22.86 x 20.32 cm
    -  The product includes wooden number cards designed to fit perfectly within the hanging bar system.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The product is printed on both sides, allowing designs to be clearly visible from the front and back without color fading.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Functions as a decorative bookshelf or wall hanging sign.
    - Includes wooden number cards that can be freely rearranged to display meaningful numbers such as days together, anniversaries, or special milestones.
    - Number cards are removable and easy to slide, allowing quick updates.
    - Suitable for hanging on walls, shelves, or display racks using the included accessories.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized wooden sign makes a thoughtful gift for everyone, suitable for any occasion, including: Anniversaries & Weddings, Valentine’s Day, Birthdays, Housewarming gifts, Christmas, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, or everyday home décor.
    - A heartfelt and decorative keepsake that celebrates love, memories, and meaningful moments.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Bookshelf Sign With Wooden Number Cards

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
